items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess/uncertain).
CONTROLS: WASD move; arrow keys fire; can move+fire. E drops bomb at feet ~1s fuse, damages self; warping does not outrun fuse. Q/Space no observed effect. Empty heart outlines + blood splatter = death.
WARP/HATCH: needs near-exact centering on visible frame plus sustained walk from ~0.1-0.2 units away; holding into frame ~1.0-1.2s usually works. Standing on frame can block; back off ~0.15, re-center, retry; multiple tries normal. Frame center may differ from room center; align to frame. Diagonal/sideways entry along top row has worked. Doorways may need y-alignment; diagonal entry sometimes works; whether diagonal strictly required unresolved (guess y-alignment matters).
TECH X: entering two-poop room auto-grants Tech X (Laser ring Tears); re-confirmed. Firing makes red squiggly laser ring lingering ~1s at fixed offset along row/column. Rocks block lasers and are not destroyed. Kills white-faced chasers at range, but they close fast; aim exactly on row/column. Red ring is own attack, not lock/telegraph (uncertain).
ROUTE/MAP: Start/mural room: top dark hatch <-> rock field; bottom dark hatch <-> torch room; right-wall ornate doorway (y~0.40-0.55, x~0.78-0.82) <-> dark chest room. Rock field: bottom hatch <-> start; top hatch <-> TNT room; left-wall gold/ornate door ~x0.19-0.20 y~0.44-0.48. Hazards: white-faced chasers near hatches transform to winged/spiked-ring forms; green glowing blobs expand/burst; spiky pellets (guess turret); spiked wheels; blue-tear shooters; spiked black rock ring with gray enemy center. Severe heart drain; don't loiter. Torch room: top hatch <-> start; gold bottom-center hatch (observed frame center ~x0.485, not necessarily 0.50) <-> two-poop room; approach centered from ~0.1-0.15 above. Center column rock-choked; safe left lane x~0.31-0.42 full height, right lane x~0.63 traversable. Center gray chest sealed by indestructible rocks: ABANDON. Corner torches (~0.25/0.75, y0.25/0.77) damage on touch. Small specks near left wall minor hazards. Two-poop room: only exit top crown/gold hatch x~0.50 y~0.09-0.17; approach from ~0.1 below; standing on frame blocks. Tech X auto-grants. Poop piles harmless/regenerate; coin pot breaks on contact for coin. Center rock vanished once; cause unknown, not attributable to lasers. TNT room: TNT barrels line left wall/mid-room, block movement, inert; don't shoot point-blank. Red-lidded brown barrels near left wall (guess key-locked). Top dark hatch <-> pink-enemy rock room; bottom hatch <-> rock field. Bomb-holding walker mid-room survived ~5-6 vertical tear volleys with no visible reaction; unclear armor/offset hitbox; treat dangerous. Left-wall gray plates inert decor; gray chests open by contact. Pink-enemy rock room (TNT top hatch): two pink fat enemies left-center; rock wall ring right with three dark teardrop objects and small blue creature (uncertain). Fat enemies observed very close; fight only at range.
DARK CHEST ROOM: entered from start right doorway. Two red-lidded unspiked chests top (~0.33,0.32),(~0.67,0.32); central spiked chest untouchable, emits spikes; small black cat-like chasers roaming (~0.33/0.67 y~0.50); yellow-green blob left (~0.26,0.48); blue/white pellets near bottom source uncertain. Pressing red-lidded chest did not clearly open/yield item. DEATH LESSON: repeated rapid heart drain even full health; high-damage death trap. Enter only with retreat and fight at range.
KEY/KEYHOLE: key counter has read 01 in runs. Rock-field left-wall gold/keyhole door tested repeatedly with key 01: pressing into it, exact vertical alignment, sustained pushes, push-while-firing-left; door did not open and key not consumed. Do not spend time/hearts. Guess: key may instead open red-lidded chests or barrels; untested.
CHESTS/BOMBS: gray chests open by contact. Bombing two-poop center rock cost heart and broke nothing; rocks judged indestructible. Never bomb at low health/adjacent to self. TNT barrels inert.
HAZARDS/HEARTS: green blobs damage on contact, transform, burst over large areas. Damage lands faster than warp setup; hits can occur in doorway frames. Mid-fight heart refill seen once; mechanism uncertain. At 1/half heart any contact ends run; flee through hatch rather than fight. At 1.5 hearts treat any contact as potentially fatal.
UNRESOLVED: keyhole/gold door condition; red-lidded chests/barrels and whether contact/key opens; bomb-walker armor/hitbox; heart-refill mechanism; meaning of red laser ring; cause of two-poop center-rock disappearance; whether doorways strictly need diagonal entry or only y-alignment; pink-room enemy behavior/rewards. Retained goals: acquire Tech X early via two-poop room; safely explore pink room; identify key use; avoid dark chest room.
